title: Observe EUR Llednar lookup and OBJ setter
changes: Add a bounded interpreter observer for the two callback lookup sites and the conditional OBJ-list setter.
validation: Wine e152-llednar-lookup-observer-wine-ro1bzrrb records both callback return addresses reading lookup indices 0 and 1, nine setter writes across three frames and original draw entries. Three observed objects already contain the list pointer before each write.
limitations: No per-object draw association, initial pointer assignment or global lookup domain is proved; other scenes, Linux, USA and native Windows remain pending. No performance measurement.
